label: GEMINI_L5_CONTINUOUS_V1
budget_labels: bounds TIGHTEN or STOP; nothing here can self-increase. Continuous operation multiplies WINDOWS, never size: the per-window envelope is the CONTINUOUS-8 one, unchanged.

pre_entry.spread_source: derived from the observed bid and ask

flow_own.why_age: a 20-second-old contract with two prints is NEW, not quiet; its rate is stated over its own age or not at all. The age is measured against the 300s EFFECTIVE window and is a FLOOR -- prints can precede it, and in 19 of 26 captured windows they did, from TTE ~377.

spot.labels: underlying movement, measured. NOT a forecast and not an input to any price, size or bound.

pre_entry.labels: PRE-ENTRY EVIDENCE, model B. Measured before any order exists. Nothing here is wired into admission, and no threshold is defined in this module.
pre_entry.sources: PUBLIC: contract prices, /v1/book/{symbol} x2, /v1/trades/{symbol}, /v1/trades/{predecessor}, /v1/trades/btcusd. No credential, no order path.

realised_flow.labels: what the window delivered, measured between its own cycles. Not a forecast and not a target.

windows.pre_entry_labels: MEASURED BEFORE ENTRY AND NOT ACTED ON. The window ran identically to one taken without it; admission is unchanged and no threshold exists.

rollover.why: the open-order list is UNREADABLE, which is not an empty one; the previous window cannot be shown finished

windows.rollover_note: the rollover gate refused and this is SHADOW: no session exists and no order could be outstanding, so the refusal is recorded and the loop continues. In LIVE this stops the run.

refusal_reasons: CROSSED book: a bid at or above its own ask

fill_conversion.why: resting seconds per fill is the honest denominator; rungs placed is reported beside it because a rung that rested four minutes and one that rested four seconds are not one sample each

habitat.labels: HABITAT EVIDENCE for model B. Not a verdict, not a tuning input, and never realized economics.

windows.labels: SHADOW: zero orders were sent and no session exists. SUBMITTED/FILLED/SETTLED/REALIZED are all zero and a recorded plan is none of them.

accounting_labels: SUBMITTED -> FILLED -> SETTLED -> REALIZED are distinct and never collapsed. realized_usd moves only on a venue-confirmed cash movement; a shadow plan, a fill, a settled contract and a mark are none of them.
